title: Smallest batch size that meets the deadline
description:
A customer must migrate a queue of jobs, in order, within `days` days. Each day they can run a batch of consecutive jobs whose sizes add up to at most the batch capacity. Bigger capacity costs more, so they want the smallest capacity that still finishes on time.

Write `smallest_batch(jobs, days)` where `jobs` is a list of positive job sizes. Return the minimum capacity such that all jobs can be run in order within `days` days. A job cannot be split across days.

**Example**

```
smallest_batch([3, 2, 2, 4, 1, 4], 3)
# 6   (days: [3, 2] [2, 4] [1, 4])
```
hints: Do not search over the jobs. Search over the possible answers.
The capacity must be at least the largest job, and never needs to exceed the sum of all jobs. That is your search range.
Write a helper that, for a given capacity, counts how many days a greedy fill takes. If it fits in `days`, try smaller. Otherwise go larger.
